info.title: VibePass API
info.description:
API endpoints for the VibePass Event Booking & OTT Streaming Explorer Platform.

**Docs**: [/docs](/docs) (Swagger UI) · [/redoc](/redoc) (ReDoc) · [/openapi.json](/openapi.json) (schema)

post.description: Generates a cryptographically secure 6-digit numeric OTP code and emails it to the user via Nodemailer.

message.example: Verification code sent to your email.

post.description: Matches verification code and email. Automatically registers new users in the database.

400.description: Invalid OTP code, missing parameters, or code expired

post.description: Accepts user Google access token, queries profile data, and upserts user details in the database.

400.description: Invalid token or Google API query failure

get.description: If `email` is passed, fetches the user's booking history records. If `eventId` is passed, returns a list of occupied seat identifiers.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: User email address to load bookings history.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Event ID to retrieve booked seats layout.

post.description: Reserves seats (pending hold) or transitions a pending booking to confirmed.

bookingStartedAt.description: Epoch timestamp when booking hold started.

cancelBookingId.description: Optional booking ID to release/cancel first.

bookingId.description: Optional existing pending booking ID to update to confirmed status.

200.description: Booking hold placed or confirmed successfully

400.description: Missing inputs or session timestamp check failure

delete.description: Releases a pending reservation from the database.

get.description: Verifies whether specified seat keys are already occupied or held for an event.

parameters.name: seats
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of seat tags to verify

verifiedSeats.description: Key-value map where true = occupied/held, false = open/available.

get.description: Retrieves real-time ticket quantity details and availability statuses (Available, Filling Fast, Sold Out) per pass tier (VIP, Gold, Silver, General).
Fetches database event listings, filtering by type, category, or location state.
Performs quick full-text wildcard search queries across event titles, category, description, and organizers.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max limit of items to return

get.description: Retrieves the list of reviews submitted for a specific event.

post.description: Saves a user rating and review text to the database and returns the updated listing.

400.description: Missing params or rating value bounds violated

get.description: Loads cumulative likes count and checks if the given user has liked the target event.

post.description: Appends a like record, incrementing event likes metrics, or removes it if already liked (toggle).

400.description: Session invalid or items not found

get.description: Fetches a full detailed list of events bookmark-favourited by a user.

post.description: Toggles event bookmark presence in the event_favourites catalog for a user.

400.description: Foreign key target or items missing

get.description: Returns cached session coordinates from internal memory mapped by sessionId.

post.description: Caches coordinate and state locality values mapping to the unique browser sessionId.

get.description: Performs cross-platform streaming catalog searches proxy-hitting TMDb when `crossOtt` is enabled. Fallbacks to searching database local events when disabled.

parameters.name: crossOtt
parameters.description: Toggles between external TMDb search and local database search

200.description: Structured lists containing stream titles, poster art, rating, overview, and links to streaming platforms.

post.description: Generates a payment intent ID and client authorization secret from the Stripe gateway.
Saves customer email feedback queries in the db userform table.

message.example: User details saved in userform table in Neon DB.

get.description: Loads all saved movies/shows in a user's TMDb media watchlist.

post.description: Saves an OTT title reference to the user's watchlist.

delete.description: Removes a bookmarked title from the watchlist catalog.

get.description: Establishes a Server-Sent Events (SSE) connection to stream database state updates.

description.example: Join the musical storm live in Bangalore.
